message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: 黄1某 is a full-time staff (事业工人) responsible for school canteen funds. He misappropriated funds from canteen account to his mother's account via forged checks, stealing seals, etc. Total misappropriated 2.8295502 million yuan, with 1.76057467 million not yet returned. He is a state employee (public staff). Crime: Embezzlement of public funds (挪用公款) by a state employee. In Chinese criminal law, the offense is "挪用公款罪" (embezzlement of public funds).
